user.title: Connect to Klydo Clock
user.description: Connect over your trusted local network. The stock ADB port provides root access without authentication. Restrict it to Home Assistant and trusted administration devices.

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered Klydo Clock
discovery_confirm.description: A stock Klydo Clock was verified at {host}. Add this clock? Its ADB port provides root access without authentication; restrict access to Home Assistant and trusted administration devices.
